title: Final speed of A
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state or calculate the correct speed of block A immediately after the collision as 2 m/s.

title: Final time for B
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state or calculate the correct time for block B to reach the ground after the collision as 0.4 s.

title: Pre-collision speed of C
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem to find the speed of ring C just before collision (4 m/s).

title: Post-collision velocity
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply conservation of linear momentum to find the common velocity of the system (A, B, C) after the inelastic collision.

title: Post-collision acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the acceleration of the combined B+C mass relative to A after the collision (5 m/s²).

title: Kinematic equation setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the kinematic equation relating displacement (h), initial velocity, acceleration, and time for the motion of B after the collision.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns signs to velocity or acceleration in the kinematic equation, leading to an incorrect quadratic solution.

title: Momentum conservation error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly includes block A in the momentum conservation for the collision, or uses an incorrect mass for the system.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates unit analysis throughout the calculation, confirming dimensional consistency.
